definitions.gloss: sole of the foot; bottom of the foot
definitions.explanation: The underside of the foot. Commonly referenced in contexts of health, massage, reflexology, and physical sensation.

examples.japanese: {砂浜|すなはま}を{歩|ある}くと{足裏|あしうら}が{気持|きも}ちいい。
examples.english: Walking on the sandy beach feels good on the soles of your feet.

examples.japanese: {足裏|あしうら}にはたくさんのツボがあると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that there are many pressure points on the soles of the feet.

notes:
A compound of {足|あし} (foot) + {裏|うら} (underside/back). A straightforward body-part term commonly seen in health and wellness contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足裏|あしうら}マッサージ: foot sole massage
- {足裏|あしうら}のツボ: pressure points on the sole
- {足裏|あしうら}が{痛|いた}い: the soles hurt
- {足裏|あしうら}ケア: foot sole care

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {足|あし}の{裏|うら}: sole of the foot — the same meaning expressed as a phrase rather than a compound
- {土踏|つちふ}まず: arch of the foot — the concave part of the sole
- {踵|かかと}: heel — the back bottom part of the foot
- {足|あし}: foot/leg — the general term
